chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn Sālim and Ibn Bukayr and more than one person, who said:

ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام was in tawaf, and he looked toward one side of the mosque at a group, and said: “What is this gathering?” They said: “This is Muḥammad ibn Shihāb al-Zuhrī. His mind has become disturbed, so he does not speak. His family brought him out, hoping that when he sees the people, he may speak.” When he عليه السلام finished his tawaf, he went out until he drew near to him. When Muḥammad ibn Shihāb saw him, he recognized him. So ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام said to him: “What is the matter with you?” He said: “I was appointed to an office, and I became involved in bloodshed. I killed a man, and what you see entered me.”

So ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام said to him: “My fear for you because of your despair of the mercy of Allah is greater than my fear for you because of what you have done.” Then he عليه السلام said to him: “Give them the blood money.” He said: “I have already done so, but they refused.” He said: “Make it into purses, then watch for the times of salat (prayer), and cast it into their house.”

key_terms.رَحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ: Allah’s mercy, from which one must not despair
key_terms.ٱلدِّيَةَ: financial compensation paid in a killing case to the victim’s family
key_terms.ٱلطَّوَافِ: circumambulation around the Kaʿbah during worship

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام say about despairing of Allah’s mercy after committing a grave sin?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام encountered Muḥammad ibn Shihāb al-Zuhrī in a state of mental distress after he had killed a man while holding authority. The Imam عليه السلام warned him that despair of Allah’s mercy was more dangerous than his sin, and instructed him to ensure the victim’s family received the diyah even if they initially refused it.
